sourceDescription: User-supplied LD_SardaukarKnifeAndSheath.webp reference. Original publication and photographer were not identified.

approval.scope: The user approved the knife-and-sheath outline proposal, then explicitly requested its previously approved catalogue import while the mouse decals were being added. The proposal presents the knife and sheath as separate decals.

preparation.description: The approved proposal silhouettes and details are preserved. White grip, blade and sheath lines become transparent cutouts through a 4x bitmap trace. Small raster fragments are removed and contours smoothed before the Dune Zone authoring and normalization pipeline.
preparation.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 8, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 1.2. Both SVGs inherit paint from their caller.

/vector/decal/sardaukar-knife.svg.details: Ring opening, crosshatched grip, blade groove and notched tip.

/vector/decal/sardaukar-sheath.svg.details: Curved silhouette, seam, rivets and two slots.
